title: Rust Clean Refactor Wave 2 — Graph Manifest
description: Wave 2 of repo-wide Rust cleanup campaign (zero rustc/clippy warnings, Result<_,String> migrated to thiserror, non-test panics reduced) for mathematical/graph/manifest/rs (package mathematical_graph_manifest). The original wave2-graph-manifest claim in the campaign's LOCKS.md was left CLAIMED since 2026-07-17T23:27:40Z with no source edits in 5+ hours — multiple downstream waves (wave3 mathgraph-dsl, wave4 graphdrawing-neuraldag, wave5 infinite-board) hit and documented this as a blocking, abandoned claim in BLOCKERS.md/CONFLICTS.md. Reclaiming it to fix the remaining clippy warnings in lib.rs: a derivable_impls (impl Default for PropertyValue), several needless_borrow calls around lines 462-478, and one op_ref at node_def.ports.iter().any. Coordinate via campaign folder LOCKS/API-CHANGELOG/CONFLICTS/BLOCKERS files at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ueli-Documents-semio/ed30c89d-3941-44d3-ae21-abf565db2f2f/scratchpad/rust-clean-refactor-campaign, verify with cargo clippy -p mathematical_graph_manifest --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test -p mathematical_graph_manifest before closing.
summary: Reclaimed the abandoned wave2-graph-manifest campaign claim on mathematical/graph/manifest/rs (mathematical_graph_manifest) — the original claimant left it CLAIMED for 9+ hours with no edits, and three later waves (mathgraph-dsl, graphdrawing-neuraldag, infiniteboard-infiniteworld) had already hit and documented it as a blocking dependency. Fixed the crate's remaining clippy warnings in lib.rs: impl Default for PropertyValue -> #[derive(Default)]/#[default], and 9 needless_borrow/op_ref sites in ManifestValidator::validate_trinity_graph. Also found and fixed the actual root cause of a recurring generated/registry.rs duplication bug that three separate waves had each hand-patched around: script.ts's findManifestFiles walk didn't exclude dot-directories, so it picked up a live git worktree (.claude/worktrees/<agent-id>/) as a second, duplicate source of every manifest.json, producing duplicate pub mod/MANIFEST_IDS/match-arm entries. Fixed by skipping dot-directories in the walk. Also fixed a separate unused-imports warning in generated/note_blocks.rs caused by emitRustManifest unconditionally emitting a serde import even for manifests (like note-blocks, which only has an unrecognized blockKinds family) that generate no code using it. Wired a "lint" script.ts/project.json target per the campaign's LINT-COMMAND-PATTERN.md. Verified cargo clippy -p mathematical_graph_manifest --all-targets -- -D warnings (clean), cargo test -p mathematical_graph_manifest (3/3 passed), cargo fmt --check (clean). Spot-checked the most direct downstream dependent (mathematical_graph): it now reaches its own compilation for the first time and surfaces 3 pre-existing warnings never previously seen (build always aborted inside this crate before) — out of scope here, flagged as a follow-up task and documented in the campaign's BLOCKERS.md/reports.
